title: 第一卷 第23章 还债
novel_title: 重回九八：我在小渔村兴风作浪
content_zh:
李华从口袋里掏出钱。

    钱叠在一起，在手上抓着，厚厚一沓，相当显眼。

    原本还在笑的张大雷一群人，都像是被摁下了暂停键，都愣在了原地。

    张大雷开赌场。

    天天经手不少钱。

    乍眼一看，李华手里的钱，差不多有个万把块。

    张大雷回过神来：“你哪弄的钱？”

    李华肯定是没有钱的。

    他借李华钱，也是调查过李华家里。

    他家里也穷的叮当响，不可能突然之间拿的出这么多钱。

    李华把钱重新塞口袋里，说道：“你管我。”

    “欠条呢？”

    “在我办公室。”张大雷眼神闪烁，露出了和善的笑容，走过来招呼道：“阿华，走走走。”

    “既然你还了钱，那咱们还是朋友。”

    “跟我来。”

    李华跟着他走进场子。

    一群赌徒围着赌桌，吵吵把火，烟味，酸臭味，还有屎尿味，熏得李华都有些头晕脑胀。

    张大雷笑道：“手痒？”

    “耍两把。”

    “我去给你拿欠条。”

    李华摇摇头，看着几个输红眼的赌鬼，心里有了计较，张大雷这场子有问题，或者说，只要是赌场，就没几个没问题的。

    他看着张大雷走进办公室，找到这几个输红眼的赌鬼，凑在耳边把张大雷那些阴招说了说。

    这几个赌鬼惊疑不定。

    李华带着他们仔细的看，其实张大雷的把戏并不高明，只要留点心就可以看出破绽。

    “我也是被坑了。”

    “好不容易才凑了钱还债。”

    “听说前段时间有个老哥，被张大雷逼得走投无路，连老婆都……唉……更惨的是，欠了换不清的债，连女儿都卖了……”

    这几个赌鬼听到这里，脸色都变了。

    他们谁不是有家有室的。

    张大雷没一会拿着欠条出来，李华接过欠条，确认无误，拿出打火机，直接烧了。

    然后，把点好钱，扔到桌子上。

    最后，转身往外走。

    张大雷招呼道：“不玩两把？”

    李华头也不回。

    就在这时。

    那几个赌鬼直接把赌桌掀了，哐当一声，桌子倒在地上，露出了下面的机关，那几个骰子被砸开，显露出里面的小机关。
content_en:
Li Hua took out the money from his pocket.

    The money was stacked together and held in his hand. It was a thick pile, quite conspicuous.

    Zhang Dalei and the others, who were still laughing, seemed to have pressed the pause button and froze in place.

    Zhang Dalei opens a casino.

    I handle a lot of money every day.

    At first glance, Li Hua had almost tens of thousands of dollars in money.

    Zhang Dalei came back to his senses: "Where did you get the money?"

    Li Hua definitely has no money.

    He borrowed money from Li Hua and also investigated Li Hua's family.

    His family was also very poor, so it was impossible for him to suddenly be able to afford so much money.

    Li Hua stuffed the money back into his pocket and said, "You take care of me."

    "Where's the IOU?"

    "In my office." Zhang Dalei's eyes flashed and he showed a kind smile. He walked over and said, "Ahua, let's go."

    "Since you paid back the money, we are still friends."

    "Follow me."

    Li Hua followed him into the venue.

    A group of gamblers gathered around the gambling table, noisily setting fires, and the smell of smoke, sourness, and feces and urine made Li Hua feel dizzy.

    Zhang Dalei smiled and said: "Itchy hands?"

    "Try two tricks."

    "I'll get you an IOU."

    Li Hua shook his head and looked at the few gamblers who had lost their money. He began to think that there was something wrong with Zhang Dalei's situation. In other words, as long as it was a casino, there were not many people who had no problem.

    He watched Zhang Dalei walk into the office, found these loser gamblers, and whispered Zhang Dalei's dirty tricks in his ear.

    These gamblers were shocked and confused.

    Li Hua took them to look carefully. In fact, Zhang Dalei's tricks were not very clever. As long as you pay attention, you can see the flaws.

    "I was tricked too."

    “It was hard to get the money together to pay off the debt.”

    "I heard that there was an old man some time ago who was forced into desperation by Zhang Dalei. Even his wife...sigh...what's even worse is that he owed debts that he couldn't exchange and even sold his daughter..."

    When these gamblers heard this, their expressions changed.

    None of them has a family or a room.

    Zhang Dalei came out after a while with the IOU. Li Hua took the IOU, confirmed it was correct, took out a lighter, and burned it.

    Then, put some money on the table.

    Finally, turn around and walk out.

    Zhang Dalei greeted: "Don't you want to play two games?"

    Li Hua didn't look back.

    Just then.

    The gamblers lifted the gambling table directly, and with a clang, the table fell to the ground, revealing the mechanism below. The dice were smashed open, revealing the small mechanism inside.
